fusions.name: Blinding Jab
fusions.desc: Jabs a target's eyes for 12 damage, stunning it for 1 second, leaving it [Blunted] for 6 seconds and 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Held Gaze
fusions.desc: Stares down everything in a cone 5 tiles ahead of you, dealing 26 damage that ignores resistance and leaving each target [Suppressed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Out of Sight
fusions.desc: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage, transcendent damage included, and no condition can take hold of you.

fusions.name: Double Take
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
